findings.current: “Heh heh. He was once a well-known demonic villain, too.
findings.defect: The translation omits that the prisoner was specifically notorious among the Demonic Cult’s fiends, erasing his organizational affiliation.
findings.rationale: 마교 explicitly means the Demonic Cult, while 마두 중에서도 알아주던 놈 identifies him as someone renowned even among its notorious villains.
findings.replacement: “Heh heh. He was once notorious even among the Demonic Cult’s fiends.
findings.source: 클클. 한때는 마교의 마두 중에서도 알아주던 놈입지요.

findings.current: I did not believe in gods, but I did believe that an omnipotent being existed somewhere above the heavens.
findings.defect: The description omits 전지, meaning that the being is omniscient as well as omnipotent.
findings.rationale: 전지전능 means both all-knowing and all-powerful; retaining both attributes preserves the full statement.
findings.replacement: I did not believe in gods, but I did believe that an omniscient and omnipotent being existed somewhere above the heavens.
findings.source: 나는 신을 믿지 않지만, 하늘 위의 전지전능한 존재가 있다는 것은 믿는다.

findings.current: No one who had lied in front of the middle-aged man had survived.
findings.defect: The draft changes the fact that no one had ever lied to him into a claim that liars had existed but were killed.
findings.rationale: 거짓을 고했던 이는 아무도 없었다 negates the existence of anyone who had told him a lie; it says nothing about such people failing to survive.
findings.replacement: Until now, no one had ever lied to the middle-aged man.
findings.source: 지금껏 중년인의 앞에서 거짓을 고했던 이는 아무도 없었다.

findings.current: *But their lives have only been extended by a few days. The outcome will not change.*
findings.defect: The plural subject broadens the threat to multiple people, whereas the thought refers specifically to Tang Sadok’s life.
findings.rationale: The immediately preceding thought names Tang Sadok as the man he should have killed, making the singular 명줄 Tang Sadok’s lifespan.
findings.replacement: *But his life has only been extended by a few days. The outcome will not change.*
findings.source: 허나 명줄이 며칠 더 늘어난 것뿐. 결과는 달라지지 않을 것이다.

findings.current: With a single step, he erased the distance between him and his destination, and the scenery blurred past.
findings.defect: The draft adds a destination and states that the entire distance to it is crossed in one step, even though the source describes distance vanishing with his steps as he travels.
findings.rationale: 한걸음에 describes the extraordinary distance covered step by step; no destination is mentioned, and the following sentence says he eventually stops at the cliff.
findings.replacement: With every step, distance vanished beneath him and the scenery blurred past.

summary: Five actionable fidelity issues: one omitted affiliation, one omitted divine attribute, and three altered facts or actions in the second scene.
